items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did that as a gas on a small group with Mandel Lowell sometimes.

ctx.x: That was NBC. I did that as a gas on a small group with Mandel Lowell sometimes. There was also George Duvivier and Dave Garroway. One Dave Garroway used do the show, I did it a couple times. I did it one time after Dave left. But, that was with NBC. That was actually before I started work at CBS. Unknown: Excuse me, Mr. Jones. I hear an alarm clock or something like that. Do you hear that?
